questions.question: What was Augustus's birth name?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus was born Gaius Octavius.
Incorrect. Gaius Julius Caesar was the name he assumed after being named Julius Caesar's heir, not his birth name.
Incorrect. Imperator Caesar was a later name he used after 38 BC, not his birth name.
Incorrect. Augustus Caesar is the name historians use for him from 27 BC until his death, not his birth name.

questions.question: When did Augustus die?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus died on 19 August AD 14.
Incorrect. 23 September 63 BC is Augustus's birth date, not his death date.
Incorrect. 15 March 44 BC is the date of Julius Caesar's assassination, not Augustus's death.
Incorrect. 2 September 31 BC is not mentioned as Augustus's death date in the article.

questions.question: What era of imperial peace began during Augustus's reign?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus's reign initiated an era of imperial peace known as the Pax Romana or Pax Augusta.
Incorrect. The Crisis of the Third Century occurred after the Principate ended, not during Augustus's reign.
Incorrect. The Principate was a style of government established during his reign, not an era of peace.
Incorrect. The imperial cult was initiated during his reign, but it is not the era of imperial peace.

questions.question: Who named Octavian as his primary heir in his will?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Octavian's great-uncle Julius Caesar named him as his primary heir in his will.
Incorrect. Mark Antony was a member of the Second Triumvirate with Octavian, not the one who named him heir.
Incorrect. Marcus Lepidus was a member of the Second Triumvirate, not the one who named Octavian his heir.
Incorrect. Marcus Agrippa was Octavian's naval commander, not the one who named him heir.

questions.question: In what year did the Battle of Actium take place?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Marcus Agrippa defeated Antony at the Battle of Actium in 31 BC.
Incorrect. 42 BC is the year of the Battle of Philippi, not the Battle of Actium.
Incorrect. 36 BC is the year Octavian exiled Lepidus, not the year of the Battle of Actium.
Incorrect. 44 BC is the year of Julius Caesar's assassination, not the Battle of Actium.

questions.question: Who succeeded Augustus as emperor?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus was succeeded as emperor by his stepson and adoptive son Tiberius.
Incorrect. Julius Caesar was Augustus's great-uncle and adoptive father, not his successor.
Incorrect. Mark Antony was defeated by Octavian and died before Augustus became emperor.
Incorrect. Marcus Agrippa was Octavian's naval commander, not his successor as emperor.

questions.question: What title did the Senate grant Octavian in 27 BC?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that in 27 BC the Senate granted him the honorific Augustus.
Incorrect. Pontifex Maximus was a title Augustus assumed after the death of Lepidus, not in 27 BC.
Incorrect. Princeps was one of the titles granted to him, but the specific honorific granted in 27 BC was Augustus.
Incorrect. Pater Patriae was one of the titles granted to him, but not the specific honorific granted in 27 BC.

questions.question: How old was Augustus when he died?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus died in AD 14 at age 75 from natural causes.
Incorrect. 51 is not the age at which Augustus died according to the article.
Incorrect. 57 is not the age at which Augustus died according to the article.
Incorrect. 76 is not the age at which Augustus died according to the article.

questions.question: Which of the following was established by Augustus for the city of Rome?
options: A postal service for private citizens
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus established official police and fire-fighting services for the city of Rome.
Incorrect. The article mentions a standing professional army, not a standing navy.
Incorrect. The article does not mention Augustus establishing a public school system.
Incorrect. The article mentions an official courier system (Cursus publicus), not a postal service for private citizens.

questions.question: Who was Octavian's mother?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Octavian's mother was Atia, a niece of Julius Caesar.
Incorrect. Livia was Augustus's wife, not his mother.
Incorrect. Cleopatra was the wife of Mark Antony, not Octavian's mother.
Incorrect. Julia was Octavian's grandmother, the sister of Julius Caesar, not his mother.
